title: Weekly report
goal: Answer questions about last week numbers from a read-only database and summarize them.

agents.name: Analyst
agents.role: Runs read-only reports and explains the result in plain language.

tools.name: run_report
tools.description: Run a saved report and return its rows.

risks.text: The database user must be read-only in the database itself: the tool says it changes nothing, the database has to agree.
